queries_to_execute.name: Self-loop count
queries_to_execute.cypher: MATCH (a)-[r:SIMILAR_TOPOLOGY]->(b) WHERE a.cell_id = b.cell_id RETURN count(r) AS self_loop_count

queries_to_execute.name: Isolated node count
queries_to_execute.cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE NOT (n)-[:SIMILAR_TOPOLOGY]-() RETURN count(n) AS isolated_count

queries_to_execute.name: Duplicate edges
queries_to_execute.cypher: MATCH (a)-[r:SIMILAR_TOPOLOGY]->(b) WITH a.cell_id AS from_cell, b.cell_id AS to_cell, count(r) AS rel_count WHERE rel_count > 1 RETURN from_cell, to_cell, rel_count ORDER BY rel_count DESC
